newsitem.title: USA: Leslie Fay reintroduces haberdashery line.
newsitem.headline: Leslie Fay reintroduces haberdashery line.

text.p: The Leslie Fay Co Inc said on Wednesday that it is reintroducing its "Haberdashery By Leslie Fay" line of women's sportswear.

For the Spring 1998 season, Haberdashery will be updated to satisfy customer demand for more color, new jacket styling and a size range from petites to extra large, said Leslie Fay, which recently exited Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
The company said the updated product line should be helped by the resurgence of synthetic fabrics in today's fashions.
Leslie Fay shares are traded in the "pink sheets" on a when issued basis, a company spokesman said.
